method_notes: LB Hillingdon Community Schools Determined Admission Arrangements 2026-27 ('Distance criterion', p.20): distance is measured in a straight line from the Ordnance Survey address point of the child's home to the agreed address point for the school, using the council's GIS (OS data). For blocks of flats with a communal entrance, the OS central point of the block is used. Ties are broken by computerised random allocation. Appendix 1 gives each community school's OS measuring point and 'distance priority radius' (1FE 500m, 2FE 750m, 3FE 1000m, 4FE 1250m). Community oversubscription criteria: 5 sibling within radius, 7 nearest within radius, 8 sibling outside radius, 9 nearest outside radius. Frithwood reserves 5 places for a nodal point. Harmondsworth and Heathrow use defined boundary areas instead of a radius. The Sept 2027 primary leaflet repeats that distance is measured in a straight line from the OS point at the home to a fixed point in the school. Every own-admission-authority summary in the Sept 2027 brochure that states a method also uses a straight line (e.g. Hillside to grid ref 510150 191063, Oak Farm to E507730 N183934, Laurel Lane main entrance to main entrance, Wood End Park to the main gate, Brookside/Hewens/Rosedale to the reception point). William Byrd gives priority to a defined area.

gaps: 2025 figures come only from the council's 'September 2026 allocation data' sheet (column 'Furthest distance offered 2025 - Metres (Excluding sibling criteria)'). The Sept 2026 brochure that would also print them was not found online: the council URL now serves the 2027 edition and there is no Wayback copy. 2024 figures come from a school-hosted copy of the Sept 2025 brochure, whose table prints no unit. They are assumed to be metres (same layout, similar magnitudes). The council shows 'N/A (F)' for faith schools and publishes no distance for them. These are recorded as all_offered where offers were below PAN (inferred), otherwise as not_published. 2025 'F' entries are all not_published because the sheet gives no 2025 offer counts. 'N/A (U)' is recorded as all_offered. Conflicts: for Warrender 2026, the sheet shows 6163 m with 60 offers but the brochure shows 'N/A (U)' with 50 offers, so it is recorded as not_published. Several schools' 2026 offer counts differ by 1-3 between the sheet and the brochure (brochure counts used). Status labels differ for Cowley St Laurence (2025 F, 2026 U) and Dr Triplett's (2025 U, 2026 F). Some large 2026 jumps (Hermitage 5149 m, Lady Bankes 3134 m, Yeading Infant 1583 m after U in 2025) are recorded as printed. PAN is the Sept 2026 figure. The brochure prints Ryefield's measuring co-ordinates identical to Hermitage's, probably an error. Postcodes come from the brochure's contact list (letter O corrected to zero), not checked against GIAS (unreachable). School types come from the brochure's map key. Academy/faith-school methods were taken from brochure summaries only, and straight line is assumed where they are silent (e.g. Cowley St Laurence, St Catherine, St Swithun Wells). Junior schools (Coteford Jr, Field End Jr, Hillside Jr, Minet Jr, Newnham Jr, Whiteheath Jr, Yeading Jr) are excluded. Infant schools are included.
